In March 1976, The Jackson 5 became the Jacksons as the group switched from Motown to Epic records. Leaving brother Jermaine back at Motown and picking up brother Randy and sisters Rebbie, La Toya and Janet for the family's Las Vegas show and primetime variety show on CBS.
